content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I want to use a [product_name] with display for my application. My requirement is to show the message "75L is filling" on the [product_name] display while filling 75L of liquid in a container. Is it possible to display such a custom text message? If anyone has experience with this, please let me know. Thank you. Best regards, [user_name]
You can check this sample—it might be helpful for your case.
A more advanced example is available that shows how to indicate fill level, temperature, and pressure as bar graphs on the display.
Thank you very much for your help. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are exploring the possibility of displaying real-time, custom text messages on the [product_name] with display, such as status updates about liquid volume. Answers suggest this feature is achievable and reference examples, though further clarification or documentation would be useful regarding display capabilities.
